key_provisions_or_claims: Producers must place only safe products on the market (general safety requirement).
Safety is assessed against national law, European standards, codes of good practice and state of the art.
Member States must designate authorities empowered to ban, withdraw and recall dangerous products.
Rapid exchange of information system (RAPEX) for serious and immediate risks, with Commission-level emergency decisions.
Without prejudice to Directive 85/374/EEC on product liability; measures must be challengeable in court.
annotation.summary_en: Council Directive 92/59/EEC established a horizontal general safety requirement for consumer products in the EU, obliging producers and distributors to market only safe products, empowering national authorities to withdraw dangerous goods, and creating a rapid information exchange system and Commission emergency measures. Later replaced by Directive 2001/95/EC.
